body:
On Fluoxetine daily. Took muscle relaxer around 9pm for shoulder pain.
Started to become drowsy around 10pm. Fell asleep and woke up in the middle of the night. Wasnt sure where I was and was sleep walking to the bathroom. Got back in bed and had strange feeling of being two separate selves.
Got back in bed and had strange feeling of being two separate selves.
Feeling like two very different things were happening to me. Fell back asleep shortly after.
Woke up around 6 or 7. Head felt like floating like Ive felt just on muscle relaxers. Felt cross eyed a few times.
Feel more relaxed and tired. Still in pain.  Might try it again another night if needed for pain.
